company.name: Miro
company.shortDescription: Miro is a software company that develops a collaborative online workspace for teams to organize, visualize, and develop ideas.
company.description: Miro is a software company that develops a collaborative online workspace for teams to organize, visualize, and develop ideas. Its platform provides an interactive canvas for brainstorming, research, diagramming, workshops, project planning, roadmapping, and other collaborative workflows. Miro supports multiple formats, including whiteboards, diagrams, tables, timelines, documents, and presentations. The platform also incorporates AI capabilities that help users generate, organize, summarize, and work with information collaboratively. Its integrations connect Miro with other business and productivity applications, while its developer platform supports extensions and custom integrations. Miro provides tools for real-time and asynchronous collaboration across product management, design, engineering, marketing, operations, and other teams. The company offers plans for individual users, small businesses, startups, and enterprises.
